newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks lower but off lows in late trade.
newsitem.headline: French stocks lower but off lows in late trade.

text.p: French stocks were sharply lower but off their session lows in late trading.
The blue-chip CAC-40 index was down 85.29 points, or 3.18 percent, at 2,595.05 at 1420 GMT. The CAC-40 futures contract was down 83 at 2,595.
The market had plunged more than four percent earlier on talk of privately commissioned polls showing the Socialists well placed for Sunday's runoff for the parliamentary election.
Franc sharply lower at 3.38 to the mark.
Wall Street lower but off its early lows.
